name: Arturo
source:
"I don't need any excuse to seek you out."

Pronouns: He/Him

A responsible man with a nurturing heart and a fondness for teasing. A workaholic CEO hell-bent on taking care of those around him, even to his own detriment! Can you convince him to finally relax?
